::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
Regularization fights overfitting — closing the gap between training and test
error: **dropout** (Srivastava 2014, random unit masking), **weight decay** (L2
penalty), **data augmentation**, and **early stopping**.
:::

**Depends on:** [Optimization — GD, SGD, Momentum](../00_foundations/06_optimization.qmd)

## Why this matters

## The mechanism

### Dropout — train an implicit ensemble

### Weight decay — penalize large weights

### Data augmentation — expand the training distribution

### Early stopping — regularize via training time
